scope: trusted local T03 quote, approval, document, outbox, commit, preflight and target read adapter

quote.query.quote_history.response: compact metadata and qualification summary; no raw internal payload

quote.query.approval_history.response: approval/effectivity metadata and payload-free event summary

quote.query.document_history.response: formal binding metadata and number/file integrity summary; no content

quote.query.outbox_history.response: queued internal event metadata and payload hash; no dispatch or delivery claim

quote.query.commit_history.response: server commit evidence metadata and result hash; no signature or delivery claim

quote.query.dispatch_preflight.response: local pre-dispatch consistency check; no external send or delivery fact

quote.query.dispatch_target.response: typed customer/contact refs and target readiness; no channel or delivery fact
